title: desmodium rotundifolium f. glabratum
intro: Desmodium rotundifolium f. glabratum, commonly known as Tick trefoil, is a variety of plant that belongs to the legume family, Fabaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Tick trefoil include the ability to soothe and calm the body, reduce fever, and aid in the treatment of various ailments, including respiratory issues and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Desmodium rotundifolium f. glabratum include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
